content: Tinidazole is supplied in the following forms: Tindamax 250 mg tablets: These are pink, round, scored tablets. One side of the tablet is debossed with TM, and the other side is marked with 250. They are packaged in bottles equipped with child-resistant caps. Tindamax 500 mg tablets: These are pink, oval, scored tablets. One side of the tablet is debossed with TM, and the other side is marked with 500. They are also packaged in bottles with child-resistant caps. Professional Samples: Specific details about professional sample packaging are not provided in this excerpt. Storage Instructions: Store the tablets at a controlled room temperature of 20–25°C (68–77°F). Short-term temperature excursions are permitted between 15–30°C (59–86°F). Protect the contents from exposure to light.
